posts.text: Thanks @Amit_Lamba , great observations and well said too…F&O was always carrying larger pie for Groww…hence, they decided to diversify into other streams. Worth noting that most of what filled the gap (MTF, commodities) is still trading-linked, so this is diversification away from F&O rather than away from market activity. The steadier test is whether the non-trading lines (AMC, wealth, lending) grow as a share over the next few quarters. posts.author: Amit_Lamba
posts.text: @Hemanpower adding to your Q2 numbers. The flat QoQ revenue is worth digging into, because it does not look Groww-specific. Total income was ₹1,541 Cr vs ₹1,549 Cr in Q1, so roughly flat QoQ, while still +44% YoY (shareholders’ letter, p.1). The letter is quite open about why: equity derivatives revenue fell 14.3% QoQ, and they attribute the bulk of it to SEBI’s Closing Auction System for F&O stocks, effective 3 August.
